notes: Regions are zero-based full-sheet [y,x,length] runs. A pixel has exactly one group; an RGB may legitimately occur in multiple group palettes. Match both region and source RGB. Never classify these assets globally by hue.
Iris/pupil regions exclude white catchlights, pale sclera and black eyelash pixels. Green shadows shared with hair remain separate by coordinates. North and north-west have no visible iris.

The coat includes the actual crimson sleeves, lapels, tails and adjacent one-pixel dark garment outlines. Gold trim, leather straps/belt, gloves, boots, trousers and steel plates are preserved. Very dark garment outlines retain their original luminance in the blue example. The magenta hair tie is not part of the coat.
Skin covers the face, ears and exposed neck; gloves are not bare hands. Mouth is separately annotated; its colours may also shade skin. medium is exactly the original skin palette.
Preview columns recolour one group at a time; all other pixels and all alpha values are unchanged. Brown and blue example mappings are review choices, not changes to the game palettes.
Schema2; exact source RGB plus zero-based full-sheet [y,x,length] spatial runs. All groups are disjoint in position; RGB may be shared across palettes.
Face, ears and bare hands are skin. Brown tunic/trousers/boots, white sleeves/metal, gold trim, eyelashes and white eye highlights are preserved.
Walking labels use each real source frame, with per-frame head alignment and explicit skin/coat spatial gates; no mirroring is baked into JSON.
No original sprite, game code, cache or tests changed. Masks and preview are review artifacts; runtime needs only JSON.
